brief: The river never has a winter. Priced on HEAD this pass: riverCol() mixes toward RIVER_COLD by RIVER_TINT 0.30 and riverRun() = 1 + RIVER_SWING 0.45 * greyF(), so the channel has seasonal COLOUR and seasonal SPEED and no seasonal STATE. The fountain's basin — about thirty cells — skins over cell by cell all winter (FOUNT_ICE 0.7, fountainIce(), fountainSkin(), ceiling FOUNT_ICE_MAX 0.43 at midwinter); the channel's 8784 water cells never do. Shoot seed 42 at t=1224 (day 23, late-winter midday, raining, every tree bare) and you will see it: the river is the most saturated, most summer-looking object in a grey-brown frame. Give it a cellular winter — an ICE state that GROWS per cell from the margins (the REED shallows, the eyot's lee, under the DECK, the still water against the quay) inward over cold days and retreats on a thaw. It must be a real CA, not a hash: a cell's chance of taking reads its FROZEN NEIGHBOURS, so the skin advances as a FRONT. Read moss[] first (courtyard.html ~line 2653: creep / shelter / the year, stepped in caTick) — it is the best CA in the town and the model here; mossShelterAt() already counts a WATER neighbour, and mossNb() is the neighbour read. Ice is a new TILE kind, so the census tileKinds must move. Everything that reads the water reads the ice: the mirror, drawRiverFlow's streaks, drawWaterShade, the ducks, and the rowboat — which does not row through ice, but boatWatch() is the best behaviour this domain has and must not die with it (the floor exists for exactly this reason; see the RIVER_SWING comment). THIS IS THE BET: a 150-300 line diff is expected and welcome, and a small one is a failure to take the swing.
successLooksLike: On a midwinter wide shot the channel is pale and skinned at its edges and open down the middle; the same river at t=175 (early summer) is unchanged to the pixel; and over a swept year the ice arrives and goes as a moving front, not as a switch — quote the frozen cell count per day across a year, at more than two seeds.
avoid: Do not freeze the whole channel: a solid white band is a worse picture than a teal one, and RIVER_SWING already says winter water runs 1.45x FASTER, so the middle stays open — the shelter term is what keeps it open, exactly as mossShel[] keeps the middle of the plaza bare. Do not re-implement the fountain's ice beside this; read it, and share what can be shared. Do not touch RIVER_TINT, RIVER_COLD or RIVER_GREEN — the seasonal tint is not the thing that is missing.
